name: IKI Medium Grants

funder.name: German Federal Ministry for the Environment, Climate Action, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety (BMUKN)

administered_by.name: IKI Office at Zukunft - Umwelt - Gesellschaft (ZUG) gGmbH

summary: Annual ideas competition of Germany's International Climate Initiative for non-profit organisations established in Germany that run two- to three-year climate and biodiversity projects with one or two local partners in developing and emerging countries.
reporting: Grantees submit an annual interim report by 30 April (progress statement with results and IKI standard indicators, plus a financial statement) and a yearly update on project results to the IKI Office.

opens.quote: The ideas competition (call) opens on 13 October 2026 and closes on 12 January 2027 at 11.59 am (CET).

deadline.quote: The ideas competition (call) opens on 13 October 2026 and closes on 12 January 2027 at 11.59 am (CET).

deadline.text: The deadline for the submission of project outlines was 20 January 2026.

status.quote: The projects for the sixth IKI Medium Grants Funding Call have been selected following a comprehensive assessment process and selection discussions involving the responsible reviewers and the relevant ministries.

deadline.quote: The deadline for the submission of project outlines was 20 January 2026.

administered_by.quote: Once the IKI Office at Zukunft - Umwelt - Gesellschaft gGmbH (ZUG) has reviewed the detailed project proposal, a final decision will be made as to funding.

applicant_types.quote: Funding is available for non-profit civil society organisations (non-governmental organisations, associations, foundations, think tanks) and academic institutions (universities and research institutions), as well as non-profit companies.

geography.quote: The IKI supports projects that contribute to the implementation of the Paris Agreement on Climate Change and the Convention on Biological Diversity in developing and emerging economies.

access.quote: In the first phase (outline phase), interested implementing organisations are invited to submit project outlines within the framework of an ideas competition.

window.quote: How often is funding provided? Annual selection procedure

amount.quote: The volume of finance provided to each project by the IKI Medium Grants can vary between EUR 300,000 and EUR 800,000.

co_finance_required.quote: The grant recipients must make an appropriate contribution to the financing of the purpose to be funded with their own funding, taking into account their financial strength.

reporting.quote: Therefore, all IKI implementing organisations must submit an annual report on the progress of their project referred to as interim reports.
